description: Twenty additive synthetic controls sealed before the next production repair is fixed or evaluated. Twelve answerability cases balance four new domains across positive, explicit-negative and absent evidence; eight mode cases cover exact diagram semantics and fact-preserving expansion.

independence.author: /root/implement_backup
independence.limitation: The author independently designed fresh cases but knows earlier failure classes. Independence is from the upcoming candidate, not blindness to historical results.
readScope: existing answerability and independent-mode corpus schemas
existing evaluation-only loaders/oracles and pinned Mermaid parser adapter

model.comparisonPolicy: Any authorized compatible model comparison is a separately named phase with exact model/helper/prompt/tokenizer identities; no best-of selection or pooled pass grade.

requestBoundary.canonical: Seed through canonical services. Retain exact source/current-revision/citation evidence, raw request, system/user/grammar, one native callback, proposals and typed canonical/asset snapshots before and after. Every proposal remains unapplied.

executionPolicy.semanticLabelRule: A required optional suggestion can be identified in ordinary prose; no exclusive colon-label regex.
executionPolicy.answerGrammarLimit: Whole-claim regexes are a declared bounded check. Faithful paraphrases outside them require separate semantic classification; never silently regrade frozen automated output.
executionPolicy.proposalAndCanonicalBoundary: A successful parse/generation does not establish correct requested effects or authorized application.

participant Clerk
participant Ledger
participant Vault

Changing a return into a solid forward message.
